messages.text:
BL-842 — Bubble Control, slice A — the bridge exposes the swarm control verbs and a live control status, driving the extension host functions Telegram Control already calls
Approval context: The confirm discipline is mine and is the piece worth a look before the coder starts.
A destructive verb needs a confirmation that is issued for ONE verb and spent ONCE. That is stricter than a boolean `confirm: true` flag, and deliberately so: a flag can be replayed by a retry, a stale tab or a do…
BL-842 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-842" (or "reject BL-842 <reason>") to act.
